title: A method to protect user data privacy and resist malicious attackers under federated learning

pse.problem: The traditional federated learning method faces challenges in protecting user privacy and resisting malicious attacks.
pse.solution_function: The invention presents a method that protects the privacy of user's local training model and ensures the accuracy of the global model under federated learning. It achieves this by using differential privacy to protect users and multi-party secure computing to resist data uploaded by malicious attackers.
pse.solution_structure: The system consists of local devices, a server, and key components for implementing differential privacy and multi-party secure computing.
pse.solution_implementation: In the local device, user data is used for local training. Differential privacy is applied to inject noise into the model to protect user privacy. The trained local model is then securely sent to the server using multi-party secure computing. On the server, the global model is updated by aggregating the received local models.
pse.effect: The solution improves user data privacy protection and resists malicious attacks, thereby ensuring the accuracy of the global model and reducing computational burdens on honest users.
